in_arabic.name: فریدون
in_arabic.meaning: فریدون تعبیر سے منفرد اور واحد شخصیت کا احساس دلاتا ہے
in_arabic.long_meaning: فریدون نام کا مطلب ہے منفرد اور انوکھا۔ یہ نام عربی زبان کے 'فرید' سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہوتا ہے منفرد، واحد اور انوکھا۔ فریدون نام کی اصیل عربی جڑیں ہیں اور اسلامی روایت میں اس کا بڑا روحانی اور ثقافتی اہمیت ہے۔ یہ نام انفرادیت اور عظمت کی علامت ہے، جو اسلامی عقیدے میں ایک انتہائی قابل ستائش صفت ہے۔ تاریخی طور پر، یہ نام اسلامی گولڈن ایج کے ممتاز شخصیات نے بھی استعمال کیا ہے، جس سے یہ ایک ورثہ اور شان کے ساتھ منسلک ہوتا ہے۔

in_urdu.name: فریدون
in_urdu.meaning: فریدون کا مطلب منفرد، واحد اور انوکھا ہوتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: فریدون نام عربی زبان کی جڑوں سے نکلا ہے، جہاں 'فرید' کا مطلب ہوتا ہے منفرد، انوکھا اور واحد۔ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلم معاشرے میں، فریدون نام کو عظمت، شان اور روحانی بلندیت کے معانی کے ساتھ استعمال کیا جاتا ہے۔ اس کا تعلق انفرادیت اور دوسروں سے مختلف ہونے کی خصوصیت سے ہے، جو اسلامی اقدار کے مطابق ایک قابل ستائش صفت ہے۔ تاریخی طور پر، یہ نام مسلم حکمرانوں اور علماء نے استعمال کیا ہے، جس سے یہ ایک اعلیٰ مقام اور ورثے کی علامت بن گیا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: फ़रीदून
in_hindi.meaning: फ़रीदून का अर्थ है अद्वितीय और एकल
in_hindi.long_meaning: फ़रीदून नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा से हुई है, जहाँ 'फ़रीद' का अर्थ होता है अद्वितीय, एकल और विशिष्ट। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, फ़रीदून नाम को विशिष्टता, महानता और आध्यात्मिक ऊँचाई के अर्थ में प्रयोग किया जाता है। यह नाम व्यक्ति की अनोखापन और दूसरों से अलग होने की विशेषता को दर्शाता है, जो इस्लामी मूल्यों के अनुसार एक प्रशंसनीय गुण है। ऐतिहासिक रूप से, यह नाम मुस्लिम शासकों और विद्वानों द्वारा प्रयोग किया गया है, जिससे यह उच्च दर्जा और विरासत का प्रतीक बन गया है।

in_pashto.name: فرېدون
in_pashto.meaning: فرېدون د انفراديت او ځانګړيتوب احساس ورکوي
in_pashto.long_meaning: فرېدون نوم د عربي ژبې څخه اخستل شوی دی، چیرته چې 'فرید' معنی لري ځانګړی، انفرادي او بې ساری. په افغان او پښتون دود کې، فرېدون نوم د عظمت، شان او روحاني لوړوالي د معنا سره کارول کيږي. دا نوم د شخص انفراديت او له نورو څخه توپیر درلودل کيږي، کوم چې د اسلامي ارزښتونو سره سم د ستاين وړ ځانګړتیا ده. تاريخي پلوه، دا نوم د مسلمانو حکمرانانو او پوهانو لخوا کارول شوی دی، نو دا د لوړ مقام او ميراث نښه ګرځيدلې ده.

in_english.name: Fareedun
in_english.long_meaning: The name Fareedun originates from the Arabic root 'farid,' meaning unique, singular, and unparalleled. In Islamic tradition, Fareedun signifies individuality, excellence, and spiritual distinction. Etymologically linked to the Quranic concept of being singular and one-of-a-kind, Fareedun is a name that embodies the values of uniqueness and distinction. Historically, this name has been used by Muslim scholars and rulers, underscoring its association with greatness and heritage. The name Fareedun reflects a personality that is seen as extraordinary and exceptional, aligning with Islamic ideals of individuality and moral excellence.

data.cultural_impact: The name Fareedun is of Arabic origin and holds a significant cultural impact within the Islamic community. The naming of a child with this name signifies the parent's hopes and aspirations for that child to grow up and be a source of liberation, not just for themselves but also for others. This can manifest in various ways, such as freeing others from hardships or providing them with knowledge and wisdom to help them gain freedom from their own obstacles. Fareedun is also a name associated with powerful and noble prophets in Islamic history, such as Prophet Ibrahim (Abraham), who was known for sacrificing his son Ishmael to please Allah and Subhan Allah (exalted is He), who later granted him the title of 'Khuda Ya'een' or 'God-knowing'. Thus, this name is also a source of inspiration and a reminder of the power of God and the significance of self-sacrifice and servitude to Him.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Fareedun holds deep spiritual significance as it is derived from the Arabic word 'Faridah' which means 'to free' or 'to liberate'. In the Islamic context, the spiritual implications of this name are manifold. It is a reminder of the ultimate goal of every human being, which is to free themselves from the bondage of their lower self, or the 'nafs' and attain the divine presence of Allah. This is achieved through obedience to Allah's commands, constant remembrance of Allah, and practicing self-discipline and self-restraint. Additionally, the name Fareedun is also a reminder of the eradication of 'Shirk' or the association of partners with Allah in worship. This is the greatest spiritual bondage that can afflict a person and can hinder them from truly experiencing the closeness and love of Allah. By bearing the name Fareedun, an individual is constantly reminded of the importance of freeing themselves from these spiritual bondages, and striving to gain inner peace and closeness to Allah.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Kathir's Al-Bidayah wa Al-Nihayah - Volume 8, Page 132. The name Fareedun carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Fareedun ibn Al-Daylam Al-Sijistani was a Persian philosopher, mathematician, astronomer, and theologian who was born around 734 AD in Sejestan (Sijistan), a region in present-day Iran. He is famous for his work on the algebraic solution of quadratic equations and was the first to prove the Pythagorean theorem geometrically using a right triangle. Fareedun's works were influential in the development of Islamic mathematics.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Al-Biruni's Kitab al-Ta'rikh al-Hind. The name Fareedun carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Fareedun Muhammad bin 'Abbad Al-Umarri, also known as Al-Farabi (Arabic for 'The Restorer'), was a prominent philosopher, scientist, and mathematician of the Islamic Golden Age. He was born around 870 AD in Farab (present-day Uzbekistan), and his works greatly influenced the development of Islamic philosophy, mathematics, and music. Al-Farabi's ideas on logic, metaphysics, and the role of the philosopher-king were especially influential in the Islamic world.
